indicator.name: Poverty headcount ratio at $8.30 a day (2021 PPP) (% of population)
indicator.sourceNote: Poverty headcount ratio at $8.30 a day is the percentage of the population living on less than $8.30 a day at 2021 international prices.
indicator.sourceOrganization: World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform. Data are based on primary household survey data obtained from government statistical agencies and World Bank country departments. Data for high-income economies are mostly from the Luxembourg Income Study database.
